external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and browser to sign in, approve consent, and manage partner connections.

external_entities.name: Partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in, obtain and use access tokens, and disconnect partner apps.

processes.name: Authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization code flows and consent, and issues tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: Rewards API
processes.description: The API called by mobile and partner applications to access loyalty rewards and the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

processes.name: Support console
processes.description: A web application used to close a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

processes.name: Member browser
processes.description: The browser used by a member to sign in, approve consent, and return an authorization code to a partner app.
processes.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_stores.name: Identity database
data_stores.description: Stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: Points ledger
data_stores.description: Stores every member's balance and every points transaction, including the client recorded for each change.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.data_description: Member interaction with the mobile app

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in and authorization code flow requests

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.data_description: Access-token-authenticated rewards requests and points data

data_flows.name: disconnect partner app
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app
data_flows.data_description: Request to disconnect a partner app and delete its refresh token

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: Client credentials and token requests

data_flows.name: sign in and consent
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in credentials and consent approval

data_flows.name: submit consent
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in and consent submission

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.data_description: Authorization code

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points
data_flows.data_description: Member points data

data_flows.name: request console token
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server
data_flows.data_description: Access-token request for the support console

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: Accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account state

data_flows.name: read and write ledger
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.data_description: Member balances and points transactions

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.
data_flows.data_description: Requests received by the rewards API, including headers

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.data_description: Member account closure state

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account in which the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: Members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The phones used by members, outside the platform's cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps

trust_boundaries.name: Partner app servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because the support console and rewards API are served on the same public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the identity database stores member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the points ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because it stores request headers, which may include security-relevant request data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every request, headers included, is written to the API log store.
